author: The Infographics Show
description:
Millennials are dying younger, and the reasons go far beyond health.
Rising death rates, burnout, and financial pressure reveal a deeper crisis shaping an entire generation.

Millennials are often labeled as lazy or entitled, but the data tells a very different story.
From skyrocketing student debt and stagnant wages to entering the workforce during a recession, this generation faced challenges that rewired how they think, work, and live. Mental health struggles, delayed milestones like homeownership and parenthood, and constant financial stress have become defining features of their lives.

At the same time, Millennials are more open about therapy, emotions, and personal growth than any generation before them.

So what really shaped them, and why does it matter for the future?
